input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance clause: the only occurrence of "insurance" is an accounting exclusion in the Net Revenue definition (p0012), and neither the Miscellaneous section (14.1–14.10) nor the Indemnification section imposes any coverage obligation on Commerce One. Commerce One is the vendor here (licensor of the Software and provider of the MarketSite Service supporting Corio and its Customers), so it sits squarely within the rule's scope. Absence of any coverage for a vendor whose service touches Customer data fails even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M), so we insert the preferred coverage package as new Section 14.10, with the existing Complete Understanding clause renumbered to 14.11.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no insurance provision, so we added our standard coverage requirements for a vendor whose software and MarketSite Service touch our and our Customers' data. We can discuss reduced limits (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber USD 2,000,000) if the preferred levels exceed Commerce One's current program.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause as new Section 14.10 and renumber Complete Understanding
